name: Indobell Insulations Ltd
about: Incorporated in May 1972, Indobell Insulation Limited manufactures insulation products.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview[1]
Indobell Insulations specializes in manufacturing insulation products like nodulated/granulated wool (mineral and ceramic fiber nodules) and prefabricated thermal insulation jackets. 
The company provides services such as consultancy, engineering, fabrication, material supply, installation, supervision, and project management. It caters to industries such as power plants, railways, aeronautics, and navigation.
Product Portfolio[2][3]
1. Manufactured Products:
   - Mineral Fiber Nodules: Used for thermal insulation, acoustic insulation, and construction.
   - Ceramic Fiber Nodules: Suitable for brake blocks, heat shields, and industrial equipment.
   - Prefabricated Thermal Insulation Jackets: Designed for energy conservation, safety, and process equipment insulation.

Services:
Thermal insulation application
Supervision
Material supply for projects
Engineering and consultancy

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 28.2%
cons: Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.12 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 202 days.
Working capital days have increased from 72.1 days to 141 days
